workstreams.name: Capture & screenshots
workstreams.description: Reproducible screenshot pipeline under tools/capture/: fictional playable library, CDP shoot script, 2× masters for the 19-shot list, contact sheet for review. Gates the visual content in the other streams.

workstreams.name: Site design & pages
workstreams.description: Layout and structure work on oscine.app: Home rewrite, new Features page, Download extensions (real asset model, checksums, requirements), Changelog page, nav/footer, sitemap and OG. Layout can start on placeholder frames; final shots come from the Capture stream.

workstreams.name: Learn & documentation
workstreams.description: How-to content: drift pass on the eight existing Learn articles against the app at rc.3, two new articles (Tools: editing tags; Keyboard & shortcuts), release-notes post-processing and the hand-written 1.0.0 notes. Runs in parallel with the design stream; only screenshot slots depend on Capture.

workstreams.name: Release & polish
workstreams.description: Everything that lands after the pages exist: drift fixes from the design doc §6, American-spelling sweep, retire PlayerFrame/mock-library, Vercel deploy hook from the app's release workflow, voice pass against the tells list, final read-through of every page.
